>
[Water Step](/Feats.aspx?ID=4351) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 59

**Archetype** [Elementalist](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=207)

**Prerequisites**
[Elementalist Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4340); water is in your elemental philosophy

</column>

---

You can Stride across liquid and surfaces normally wouldn't support your weight. This benefit lasts only during your movement. If you end your movement on a surface that can't support you, you fall in or it collapses as normal.
